title: Nutritious Mild Saudi Arabian Chicken Tagine
description: A quick-fix Saudi Arabian dish featuring a mix of fruits, chicken, and spices, cooked in a clay pot, with anti-inflammatory properties. This recipe combines the flavors of mustard and cream to create a unique taste experience.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a clay pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the mustard paste, canned diced tomatoes, prunes, apricots, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir well to combine, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
